post.summary: Upload a wallpaper (type=BG) or a firmware file (type=OTA)
post.description:
For BG, name must start with the wallpaper slot number 2-7 (e.g. 3-cat.jpg); delete the existing wallpaper in that slot first. The image must be at most 3940 x 2500 pixels with a width/height ratio between 1.5 and 2.0 (e.g. 16:9, 16:10); otherwise errorCode 1200 is returned.

For OTA, name must be update.zip; data is false if the firmware is for a different model.

To import a configuration file, use PUT /api/v2/station/system/config instead.

mode is required.

Bridge (networkMode 1) works only with mode 1 (AP); switch to NAT before setting mode to 0 or 2.

The station reboots automatically when networkMode or channel changes; changing networkMode also switches Ethernet (LAN1) to DHCP.

ssid is required and must appear in GET /api/v2/station/wifi/list; otherwise the request does not return.

Encode the password before sending: replace \ with \\\\, then URL-encode it twice.

get.description:
With hasNew=true, data is an object with current and new.

With hasNew=false (default), data is only the current version string, e.g. 1.0.0.84(20261012).

parameters.name: hasNew
parameters.description: When true, check the OTA server for a newer version

post.summary: Install the firmware file and reboot into recovery to update
post.description:
With isManual=true, upload update.zip with POST /api/v2/station/upload (type=OTA) first; with isManual=false, download it with PUT /api/v2/station/firmware/download/start first.

Returns false if the file is missing or invalid.

On success the station reboots automatically, although rebootRequired is false.

parameters.name: isManual
parameters.description: true: install the uploaded file; false: install the file downloaded from the OTA server

put.summary: Start downloading the latest firmware from the OTA server
put.description:
Call it again every few seconds to get the progress until status is 2, then install it with POST /api/v2/station/firmware (isManual=false).

If a download fails, the next call starts it again.

status.description: -1: no newer firmware available, 1: downloading, 2: download complete

value.errorMsg: Fail: Nothing happened

get.summary: List the connected USB camera, speaker and microphone
get.description:
AS-301 only.

A device with both functions (e.g. a speakerphone, or a camera with a microphone) is listed in each group.

Only one USB audio device is recognized at a time.

In wired BYOM mode, peripherals are passed through to the laptop and not listed.

connected: a display is detected; active: the port is outputting; resolution: current output mode; dualDisplay: extended (true) or mirrored (false).

The external display's power state cannot be detected.
